title: GemDetox at TextDetox CLEF 2025: Enhancing a Massively Multilingual Model for Text Detoxification on Low-resource Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of text detoxification (rewriting toxic text into neutral text) for a shared task competition. It evaluates system performance using automated metrics like Style Transfer Accuracy and semantic preservation, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
